verdict.rationale: Godot's docs confirm a headless display server + dummy audio driver mode intended for dedicated servers/CI (godot-docs-19) and a full CLI for running scripts and projects without the editor (godot-docs-3/12, godot-probe-4, godot-probe-rt-1), which together enable scripted/CI execution against the real engine. However, no evidence shows an official or documented unit/integration test framework (e.g., GUT, gdUnit) or CI pipeline example that runs game-code tests headlessly — only the underlying headless/CLI primitives are evidenced. missing for 10: official test-runner/framework docs, concrete CI pipeline example, independent confirmation of headless test execution in practice.
